filters.blacklist_and_forbidden_chroms_note: both are correctly empty here, not omissions, despite the certificate recording 5,998 blacklist members and 5 forbidden chromosomes: the certificate's blacklist is built from unversioned gene roots but compared here against this census's versioned gene_id, so it can never match -- a dead filter by construction, reproduced on purpose (see slot_gene_sets' docstring); and the census's own allowed_chromosomes (21 entries) already excludes every forbidden chromosome at build time, so restating them here would be redundant, not corrective, over this input

no_feasible_rung_reason: margin >= 0.25 holds on every evaluated rung, but exact feasibility and the powered_for_every_rho Psi verdict are each individually satisfiable on this ladder and never by the same rung: the largest exactly-feasible rung is N=600 (Psi verdict 'conditional_on_rho'); the smallest rung with a powered_for_every_rho Psi verdict is N=729 (exact feasibility fails, shortfall=109)

necessary_counts.residual_unique_genes_per_slot_not_joint: available - demand per slot/union, exactly as necessary_counts' own margin column defines it. This double-counts genes shared across slots (e.g. the donor_phase_2/acceptor_phase_2 overlap in the real pool) -- it is NOT a jointly realizable holdout. See `joint_residuals` for the max-flow-exact figure: the genes actually left over once this rung's demand is satisfied.

direction.lower_bound_reason: this lattice has fewer than 3 cells per delta class, so the M_delta variance formula omits the uncancelled donor/acceptor module component, (u_a-u_b)/2 + (v_b-v_a)/2, that a full 3x3 design cancels; simulation shows a ~2.3x understatement for the rotated 2x2 -- see var_direction's docstring
